newsitem.title: USA: Cross Timber sets $120 mln '97 capex budget.
newsitem.headline: Cross Timber sets $120 mln '97 capex budget.

text.p: Cross Timbers Oil Co said on Tuesday its board approved a capital budget of $120 million for 1997, with $70 million for its ongoing development program and $50 million to fund acquisition expenditures.

Cross Timbers said it expected to fund the budget internally, with cash flow and selective asset sales. This budget was part of the company's strategy of increasing 1997 cash flow to $5.50 per share, it said.
Cross Timbers also said it planned to drill 173 wells in 1997, including 114 gas and 59 oil wells. It also planned 80 workover and recompletion activities.
About 10 percent to 20 percent of the budget would be allocated to higher-risk projects, including step-out development wells and exploratory drilling, it said.
Much of the higher-risk activity would focus on the Tubb Formation in Lea County, New Mexico, where the Cross Timbers has more than 6,200 gross acres, it said.
